description: Show (or, typing:false, stop) the typing indicator in an iMessage conversation, and read:true marks it read (a read receipt). Only in a conversation that already exists, and not in group chats. Free. Needs the brand's own Sendblue or LoopMessage account connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

seconds.description: LoopMessage: how long to show it, up to 60

to.description: the person (phone number or Apple Account email)

typing.description: default true; false stops it (with read:true and typing:false, only marks read)

name: imessage_typing
title: iMessage typing and read
